This is weak evidence of implementation because the declaration did not become a tangible peace step.","question_ids":["8B.6","8B.1","7B.8"]},{"title":"The Wagner mutiny exposed a serious rupture in implementation and command","publisher":"Reuters via Reuters Connect","date":"24 Jun 2023","url":"https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/moment-putin-says-wagner-mutiny-is-treason-in-televised-address/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMucom,2023:newsml_VA240124062023RP1","summary":"Putin publicly called the rebellion treason and promised punishment, but the mutiny itself showed that state control and coercive follow-through were not seamless.","question_ids":["8B.6","8B.3","8B.5"]}]}
